text:
alana: Heads up — noticed duplicate page fetches in the onboarding sample app when the Python SDK is exercised with a short burst. Go SDK doesn't show this.

alana: Repro steps (local): run sampleapp-prefetch against local-staging, spawn ~40 concurrent pagination clients. After a couple token refreshes the same next_page_token gets processed twice.

alana: Relevant trimmed logs: 
```
INFO fetch_page page=2 inflight=7
ERROR token_refresh failed, retrying
INFO fetch_page page=2 inflight=8
INFO fetch_page page=2 inflight=8  # duplicate work observed
```

mohit: quick question — is the inflight permit counter owned by the paginator or by the request runner layer? :eyes:

alana: it's the client-side inflight semaphore in client/prefetch/windowing.py. My suspicion: token refresh raises, the retry path re-enqueues without releasing the permit. I can reproduce with a small script.

jen: which python sdk version and any custom backpressure config?

alana: py-sdk 0.8.2, default permits=16, prefetch=2. Go team on 0.8.3 couldn't repro.

samir: CI flagged a similar flake last week — @ci-bot can you paste the flaky test link?

ci-bot: https://ci.redwood/example/test-suite/flake-231 — flaky.test: test_pagination_race (token refresh interleaving).

mohit: hypothesis: the token refresh/401 retry path doesn't use finally/release semantics in the python backoff wrapper. If a retry throws and we requeue, we may double-count inflight.

alana: minimal local fix (pseudo):
```py
# before
try:
    do_request()
except AuthError:
    retry_request()
# missing release on early return

# after
acquire_permit()
try:
    do_request()
except AuthError:
    retry_request()
finally:
    release_permit()
```

jen: that matches expectations. Can you open a PR with unit + integration tests simulating concurrent token refresh + pagination? Add assertion that inflight counter returns to 0 after drain.

alana: yes — will add an instrumentation metric inflight_leaks counter too to catch regressions.

mohit: once PR is up ping me — we should backport to the 0.8.2 patch branch (customers onboarding on that).

samir: also useful to add a short note in sampleapp README about SDK parity on token handling to reduce support noise.

alana: will add a troubleshooting section for "duplicate page results" with the token-refresh workaround and the failing log snippet.

jen: nice triage. :thumbsup: include the failing logs in the PR description so QA can add an e2e check.

alana: opening PR in ~30m, thanks all. :pray:
